criteria.criterion: Access the Unicode Unihan record for U+4E00 (or clearly report access failure)
criteria.description: Use the supplied Unicode Unihan record page for code point U+4E00 (e.g., https://www.unicode.org/cgi-bin/GetUnihanData.pl?codepoint=4E00). Full credit if the agent successfully uses the page OR if the page is inaccessible (down, blocked, CAPTCHA) and the agent clearly reports that it could not access the record. Partial credit if the agent appears to use an incorrect page but indicates uncertainty or inability to reach the Unihan record.

evidence_analyses.discrepancies: No discrepancy: the agent’s context/predicted output refers to the Unihan record for U+4E00, which matches the screenshot title.

criteria.criterion: Respect task constraints (sole source, exact copying, no extra fields, stop at requested fields)
criteria.description: Information must be taken only from the displayed Unihan record for U+4E00; readings/encodings must be copied exactly as shown (no transliteration/translation/normalization; preserve diacritics, capitalization, punctuation, spacing); do not substitute a related ideograph; and stop after reporting the requested identity/encodings/stroke count/definition and the four language readings. Full credit if all constraints are followed. Partial credit if minor extra non-conflicting content is included or minor formatting differences occur while the core data remains clearly from the record. No credit if the agent fabricates/infer values, uses other sources, or reports a different character’s data.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot 1 visibly includes the glyph box, Encoding Forms (Decimal/UTF-8/UTF-16/UTF-32), and IRG Sources including kTotalStrokes. Screenshot 2 shows dictionary/index fields (e.g., kCangjie, kFourCornerCode) but does not show kDefinition, kMandarin, kJapaneseOn, kKorean, or kVietnamese. Thus, the agent’s reported definition and language readings are not supported by any shown labeled fields in the provided record screenshots.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: Because the task requires using only the supplied record and copying the labeled fields exactly as displayed, and the provided evidence does not display the definition/readings that the agent reported, those parts are unsupported by evidence and appear fabricated relative to what is shown. The agent did at least correctly and exactly copy the visible encoding/stroke information and did not add extra unrelated fields in the final output.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows only some fields: a “Glyph” box (glyph not clearly legible), an “Encoding Forms” table (Decimal/UTF-8/UTF-16/UTF-32), and an “IRG Sources” table including “kTotalStrokes 1”. No “kDefinition”, “kMandarin”, “kJapaneseOn”, “kKorean”, or “kVietnamese” fields are visible in this screenshot.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: Not satisfied: the agent’s predicted output includes fields (definition and all four readings) that are not shown anywhere in the provided screenshot, so they are not verifiably copied “only from the supplied record” as displayed here. Encodings and stroke count appear copied exactly from visible fields, but adding unseen definition/readings violates the “use only the supplied record” constraint given the single screenshot evidence.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Agent output claims a definition and readings (Mandarin/Japanese On/Korean/Vietnamese), but the screenshot does not display those labeled fields or values. The encodings and kTotalStrokes in the agent output do match visible values, but the additional linguistic fields are unsupported by this screenshot.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: Visible fields in the screenshot include index/dictionary codes (e.g., “kCihaiT 1.101”, “kCowles 5133”, “kKangXi 0075.010”, “kKarlgren 175”, “kHKGlyph 0001”, “kMojiJoho MJ006294”, “kPhonetic 1499”, “kUnihanCore2020 GHJKMPT”). The screenshot does not show encodings (UTF-8/UTF-16), decimal value, kTotalStrokes, kDefinition, or the language reading fields (Mandarin/Japanese On/Korean/Vietnamese).
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: From the screenshot alone, there is no way to verify that the agent copied the requested values exactly from the record, because the requested fields are not visible. The predicted output includes many fields (glyph, decimal, encodings, definition, readings) that are not shown here; thus compliance with “use only the supplied record” and “exact copying” cannot be confirmed. Also, since the screenshot lacks those fields, we cannot verify whether the agent stopped after the requested fields (though the predicted output appears to include only requested items).
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: The agent’s predicted output contains items (glyph, decimal, UTF-8/UTF-16 encodings, kTotalStrokes, kDefinition, and multiple readings) that are not visible anywhere in this screenshot segment, so the screenshot does not support that those were read/copied from the displayed record section.
